shared_elements: human-derived motifs (glyph faces in A; full human figures in B)
justification: A shows dense columns of rectangular, repeated sign-blocks packed edge to edge into vertical registers, while B shows two isolated, sparsely placed stick-like human figures with raised arms holding long linear weapons on an open field. The only faint commonality is that both employ highly schematic renderings of humanoid features; the organizing principle (grid of repeated signs vs. free-standing narrative figures) is entirely different.
